Sandrine Takumi Finch is a master practitioner, fascia-therapist and reflexologist based in France. Sandrine Takumi is specialised in Japanese massage therapies and is the founder of Institut Takumi Finch where you can learn about innovative and ancestral massage techniques. Sandrine Takumi is an active researcher in the Science of Touch. As a fervent ambassador of Japanese massage techniques, you can hear Sandrine Takumi speak at international beauty and scientific congres.

🎓 Head of Institut Takumi Finch
👐 Specialised in therapeutic Kobido
🙋 Founder of Facio-therapy Method 
🇯🇵 Dedicated to Japanese Therapeutic Arts

The Institut Takumi Finch, through its founder Sandrine Takumi Finch, is dedicating its social media to:
 • YouTube channel Sandrine Takumi Finch : learn all about the science of touch
 • Instagram : a day in the life of a master practitioner
 • LinkedIn : Institut Takumi Finch training centre 

https://www.takumifinch.com/
